rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and injuries to the policyholder caused by another driver's negligence.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan, POL-1003, was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at ~8:15am at a red light by another vehicle traveling ~35 mph without braking. Policyholder's vehicle is totaled (trunk crushed into back seat), and policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information; $750 deductible applies, $100k policy limit.

case_facts.description: other driver hit claimant's vehicle at ~35 mph without braking; trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled — trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info documented
